design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, and functional. Designed as a clinical command center for MRI diagnostics. Emphasizes data clarity, trust, and diagnostic accuracy. High contrast interface.

layout_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard, using tight spacing gap-4 or gap-6 for dashboards.
layout_spacing.container_style: Grid Borders - border-collapse style layout. 1px solid borders border-border, no soft shadows.

surface_styles.dashboard_cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px border-border, no shadow, sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).
surface_styles.header: Solid white background with a hard 1px bottom border.

motion_interactions.hover_states: Explicit hover states. hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white for buttons.
motion_interactions.animations: Minimalist micro-interactions. Only use for feedback.

image_urls.description: Doctor examining MRI, use for empty state or hero.
Man talking to doctor with MRI on laptop.

components.file_upload: Drag and drop zone. dashed border-2 border-border, hover:border-primary bg-surface/50 p-12 text-center
components.prediction_viewer: 2x2 grid layout. Original MRI, Segmented Cord, Binary Mask, Disease Overlay. Use aspect-square containers with bg-black for high contrast viewing of medical images.
components.classification_result: Large typography for label. Use diagnostic_classes colors for indicators. Show confidence score prominently.
components.history_panel: Dense table layout. Use Shadcn Table. No card borders around the table, let it sit in the grid.
components.metrics_view: Simple rectangular bars for Dice Score and IoU.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. e.g., data-testid='upload-mri-zone'.

instructions_to_main_agent: The application is a medical AI dashboard. Use Archetype 4 (Swiss & High Contrast).
Layout should be dense, data-driven, and utilize 1px borders everywhere. Avoid soft shadows.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural dashboard layouts, do not rely on generic Cards.
Ensure the layout can accommodate four simultaneous MRI views (Original, Segmented, Mask, Overlay).
Use the provided image URLs as fallbacks or empty-state visuals if needed. Never use via.placeholder.com.
Write components in .js or .jsx as configured in the frontend.
Ensure typography strictly follows the guidelines and adds a professional medical feel.
